== Description ==

The stream area at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025: [[Joe Olson]] (front left) and [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] (back to camera) at a table with [[Logan Pietig]] (seated, right); behind them [[Matt Scott]] (standing, black Nike track jacket) and [[Mike Kessling]] (standing, blue T-shirt) near the stream table with [[Jonny Chu]] (standing), [[Benji Chu]] (black cap), and [[Brian Fred]] (seated); remaining faces unlabeled.
